R01_INVALID_FORMAT: GSTIN must be 15 alphanumeric characters matching standard GST format.
R01_INVALID_STATE: State code '{state_code}' in GSTIN is invalid (must be 01-38, 97, or 99).
R01_INVALID_CHECKSUM: The GSTIN check digit doesn't match. Re-check the number on the bill.
R02_TAX_MISMATCH: Calculated tax Rs {expected} does not match total tax Rs {actual} (tolerance Rs 1.00).
R02_TOTAL_MISMATCH: Calculated total Rs {expected} does not match invoice total Rs {actual} (tolerance Rs 1.00).
R03_INTRA_STATE_IGST: Intra-state supply (same state {state}) cannot charge IGST. Must charge CGST + SGST.
R03_INTER_STATE_CGST_SGST: Inter-state supply (business state {business_state} to party state {party_state}) cannot charge CGST/SGST. Must charge IGST.
R04_RATE_MISMATCH: Tax rate {actual}% does not match HSN {hsn} (expected {expected}% as per rate table).
R04_UNVERIFIED_RATE: Rate looks consistent with the draft table, but the table is not verified. Confirm the rate.
R04_HSN_NOT_FOUND: HSN / category '{hsn}' not found in official rate table.
R05_DUPLICATE_INVOICE_NO: Duplicate invoice number '{invoice_no}' already exists for GSTIN {party_gstin}.
R05_DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION: Duplicate transaction detected for party '{party_name}' on date {invoice_date} with total Rs {total}.
R06_FUTURE_DATE: Invoice date {invoice_date} is in the future (current date {current_date}).
R06_OUTSIDE_PERIOD: Invoice date {invoice_date} is outside the selected return period {period}.
R07_MISSING_GSTIN: B2B supply is missing mandatory recipient GSTIN.
R07_MISSING_INVOICE_NO: Invoice number is mandatory but missing.
R07_MISSING_DATE: Invoice date is mandatory but missing.
R08_SEPARATE_TAX: Composition scheme dealers cannot charge separate tax on invoices.
R08_INTER_STATE: Composition scheme dealers cannot make inter-state outward supplies.
R09_ZERO_OR_NEGATIVE: Entry has zero or negative taxable value or total amount.
R09_OUTLIER_AMOUNT: High transaction value of Rs {amount} detected for micro-business threshold.
R10_NEARING_LIMIT: Cumulative turnover Rs {turnover} has reached {pct}% of {scheme} scheme limit Rs {limit}.
